title: Account Director
description:
About DAVID

DAVID is a global creative boutique founded in 2012, with offices in Miami, New York, Madrid, Buenos Aires, São Paulo, and Bogotá. The network of agencies – which is a part of WPP and Ogilvy's global creative network – is recognized for its creative reputation, with over 200 Cannes Lions in its history, including Grand Prix and Titanium Lions. It has also earned several EFFIE awards, highlighting DAVID's ability to build strong brands through creativity. DAVID has been named Agency of the Year at some of the most prestigious festivals, including D&AD, The One Show, and The Clio Awards.

The network is responsible for campaigns for major brands such as Google (Android and Google), Mondelez, Coca-Cola, Burger King, AB InBev, Supercell, Netflix, and Kraft-Heinz. Some of its most recent standout work includes iPager (Android), Meet Marina Prieto (JCDecaux), Breathe Through It (Halls), #TurnYourBack (Dove), The Bald Thru (Burger King); and Alcaraz Signs (Netflix).

Throughout its history, DAVID has been one of the most recognized agencies for creating Super Bowl commercials, producing 9 spots over 6 years. In 2019 alone, the agency created commercials for three different clients (Burger King, Kraft Heinz, Budweiser).


About the Role

The Account Director brings value to our clients by analyzing, solving, and presenting viable integrated solutions to client pain points. They identify and inspire new workstreams and solutions that lead to client growth, collaborating with and drawing upon the expertise of DAVID's vast resources and capabilities. The Account Director is a trusted advisor and partner to senior brand managers and marketing/category directors, as well as agency leaders at similar levels. They are exceptional leaders of teams, inspiring others to act courageously, and championing great creative work. They will be heavily involved with the execution and management of individual projects and campaigns.


What You’ll Do

  • Build strong client relationships
  • Partner with DAVID's capability experts to deliver integrated solutions, identify new business opportunities, scope of work, and revenue
  • Manage account teams
  • Look for opportunities and formulate plans to manage and exploit them to drive business
  • Put clients first, interfacing regularly with all client levels and constantly striving for innovative solutions and big ideas
  • Demonstrate strong collaboration skills with internal teams, pulling together agency resources to effectively and seamlessly support your client’s business
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with creative and strategic partners, effectively navigating conflicting priorities
  • Ensure projects are on time, within budget, and meet client expectations
  • Demonstrate responsibility and accountability for overall agency performance and flawless delivery


What You’ll Need

  • 10+ years’ experience in account management, including 3-5 years of supervisory experience
  • Strong understanding of marketing and advertising principles, including digital marketing
  • An appreciation for how great work gets done, and a commitment to ensuring creative excellence
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and prioritize effectively
  • Passion for our industry
  • Diplomatic, empathetic leadership
  • Excellent listening skills and the ability to read the room and adapt accordingly

Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click here for more details.

$100,000-$230,000 USD

What You’ll Do

  • Lead creative projects across digital, bringing ideas to life with originality, strategic thinking, and precision using AI.
  • Lead and refine AI production workflows across projects, setting the standard for AI-integrated creative execution.
  • Own the content creation process end-to-end—from concept and scripting to execution—using AI as a creative accelerator.
  • Originate and pitch concepts that leverage the latest AI video and content technologies.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to demonstrate how AI can solve complex or “impossible” creative briefs—faster, better, and more imaginatively.
  • Design and execute AI-driven social media strategies that grow reach, engagement, and conversions.
  • Spot trends early and translate them into compelling, platform-native content.
  • Collaborate with marketing, PR, and leadership teams to transform strategic ideas into engaging stories and campaigns.
  • Adapt content for different audiences while maintaining a cohesive brand voice and aesthetic.
  • Maintain and evolve client brand guidelines while integrating AI tools to improve scalability, efficiency, and creative experimentation.
  • Direct deliverables across multiple projects, ensuring work is on time, on budget, and aligned with brand standards.
  • Experiment with emerging AI tools to streamline research, spark creativity, and optimize production workflows.
  • Track performance, test formats, iterate quickly, and optimize content based on data and results.
  • Direct and mentor a team of video creators, ensuring output meets high-end cinematic and creative quality standards.

What You’ll Need

  • 7+ years of experience in visual design, art direction, and creative strategy.
  • A strong foundation in branding, visual design, and user experience.
  • High degree in Graphic and/or Web Design, or equivalent professional experience.
  • A powerful design portfolio demonstrating originality, innovation, problem-solving, and personal expression, ideally including AI-enhanced work. Portfolio should include examples of visual design, branding, presentation decks, graphic design, print, and information visualization, AI solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with AI creative tools such as Google AI models, VEO 3, OpenAI Nano Banana, Seedance, Adobe Firefly, Runway, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with AI tools for content creation, ideation, editing, and trend analysis.
  • Ability to bridge the gap between traditional cinematic craft and the frontier of Generative AI.
  • Proven experience creating audiovisual content across digital channels.
  • Expert-level proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign).
  • Knowledge of designing social assets, visuals, video storytelling.
  • Strong understanding of what performs on each platform—and why.
  • Ability to hook trends, visuals, and data, turning ideas into scroll-stopping content that drives real results.
  • Experience generating content ideas and scripts and repurposing content efficiently across platforms.
  • A natural storyteller with excellent taste, style, and design sensibility.
  • Result-oriented mindset with a focus on reach, engagement, growth, and impact.
  • Ability to think in visuals, narratives, and data.
  • Highly motivated with a high level of initiative and the ability to work independently in support of the agency’s creative goals and the client’s business objectives.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, set priorities, utilize resources, identify and address problems, meet deadlines, and stay within budget.
  • Exceptional at your craft and a strong project owner.
  • Fascination with innovation and technology.
  • Ability to move fast, experiment, and execute without hand-holding.
  • Passion for turning complex ideas into content people actually care about.
  • Content strategy experience with experience in intersection of AI, creative strategy, art direction, storytelling, design, and performance.

How We’ll Support You

Ogilvy celebrates its people. Fully. Enthusiastically. Unhesitatingly. We’ll empower you with the tools you’ll need to succeed. We’ll give you the autonomy to seek out new paths and better ways of doing things. We’ll support you with colleagues who are experts in their disciplines, drawn from across the Ogilvy network. And we’ll provide opportunities for you to do work of which you’ll be proud, with people you’ll be proud to call your teammates.

  • Experience leading and mentoring other strategists and planners
  • Ability to work directly with clients and develop relationships accordingly on behalf of the agency
  • Rigorous brand building capabilities, without a rigid approach
  • Demonstrated talent for abstract thinking, spotting trends and patterns, an innate curiosity and insight into human behavior, instinct for popular culture, and a nuanced understanding of creative work

title: INTERNATIONAL SENIOR ACCOUNT MANAGER
description:
¿Eres un/a líder estratégico/a con pasión por la construcción de marcas globales y experiencia en la gestión de cuentas de gran envergadura? ¿Te entusiasma la idea de trabajar con un cliente icónico a nivel mundial desde una de las agencias más creativas e influyentes?

En DAVID, somos una agencia de publicidad globalmente reconocida por nuestra creatividad audaz y estratégica que transforma marcas y conecta con audiencias de maneras inesperadas. Buscamos talento que no solo entienda el pulso del mercado, sino que también tenga la visión de moldearlo.

La Oportunidad:

Buscamos incorporar a nuestro equipo de Madrid un/a Senior Account Manager Internacional para liderar la gestión estratégica de una de nuestras cuentas más importantes a nivel global. Serás el enlace principal con un cliente líder indiscutible en su categoría a nivel mundial, una marca con una presencia masiva y una resonancia cultural profunda. Esta es una oportunidad única para impactar en campañas que llegan a millones de personas, trabajando en un entorno dinámico y en constante evolución.

Tu Misión será:

  • Liderar la relación estratégica con los stakeholders clave del cliente a nivel global, actuando como un socio estratégico de confianza.
  • Desarrollar e implementar planes de comunicación integrados y estrategias de marca a gran escala, asegurando que los objetivos del cliente se cumplan con excelencia creativa y estratégica.
  • Supervisar la ejecución de campañas internacionales complejas, coordinando equipos multidisciplinares internos (creativo, estrategia, producción, medios) para garantizar la entrega de trabajo de la más alta calidad y en plazos establecidos.
  • Identificar y proponer proactivamente oportunidades de crecimiento para la cuenta, así como soluciones innovadoras a los desafíos del cliente.
  • Gestionar el presupuesto y la rentabilidad de la cuenta, asegurando la eficiencia y el valor para ambas partes.
  • Mantenerse al día con las tendencias del mercado global y la competencia, aportando insights valiosos para el cliente y la agencia.
  • Actuar como embajador/a de DAVID, fomentando una cultura de excelencia, colaboración y pensamiento disruptivo.

Lo que Buscamos en Ti:

  • Experiencia: Mínimo de 5 a 7 años de experiencia probada en gestión de cuentas, con al menos 3 años en el liderazgo de cuentas internacionales complejas en agencias de publicidad o marketing de reconocido prestigio.
  • Perfil de Cliente: Historial exitoso en la gestión de clientes multinacionales de gran envergadura, preferiblemente en el sector de bienes de consumo masivo (FMCG/CPG).
  • Idiomas: Dominio bilingüe (nativo o equivalente) del inglés, indispensable para la interlocución diaria con el cliente y los equipos globales. Se valorará positivamente el conocimiento de otros idiomas.
  • Habilidades de Interlocución: Capacidad demostrada para construir y mantener relaciones de alto nivel con clientes, actuando como un consultor estratégico y negociador/a experto/a.
  • Pensamiento Estratégico: Mentalidad analítica y estratégica, con capacidad para desarrollar e implementar planes de comunicación integrados a escala global.
  • Liderazgo: Habilidades de liderazgo de proyectos y equipos, con capacidad para inspirar y motivar.
  • Comunicación: Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita, así como de presentación.
  • Proactividad y Autonomía: Capacidad para trabajar de forma independiente, tomar decisiones y gestionar múltiples proyectos bajo presión en un entorno dinámico.
  • Orientación a Resultados: Visión de negocio y enfoque claro en la consecución de objetivos.
  • Ubicación: Residencia en Madrid y disponibilidad para viajes internacionales ocasionales.

Qué te Ofrecemos:

  • La oportunidad de formar parte de una de las agencias creativas más influyentes a nivel mundial.
  • Gestionar una cuenta global de prestigio con un impacto real en millones de personas.
  • Un entorno de trabajo dinámico, colaborativo y multicultural, donde la creatividad es el motor.
  • Salario competitivo acorde a la experiencia.
  • Desarrollo profesional continuo y oportunidades de crecimiento dentro de DAVID.
  • Integrarte en un equipo apasionado y talentoso en nuestras oficinas de Madrid.

¿Estás listo/a para asumir este emocionante desafío y dejar tu huella en el mundo de la publicidad global?

Si crees que tienes el perfil que buscamos y estás preparado/a para llevar tu carrera al siguiente nivel, ¡queremos conocerte!

title: Senior Producer
description:
About DAVID

DAVID is a global creative boutique founded in 2012, with offices in Miami, New York, Madrid, Buenos Aires, São Paulo, and Bogotá. The network of agencies – which is a part of WPP and Ogilvy's global creative network – is recognized for its creative reputation, with over 200 Cannes Lions in its history, including Grand Prix and Titanium Lions. It has also earned several EFFIE awards, highlighting DAVID's ability to build strong brands through creativity. DAVID has been named Agency of the Year at some of the most prestigious festivals, including D&AD, The One Show, and The Clio Awards.

The network is responsible for campaigns for major brands such as Google (Android and Google), Mondelez, Coca-Cola, Burger King, AB InBev, Supercell, Netflix, and Kraft-Heinz. Some of its most recent standout work includes iPager (Android), Meet Marina Prieto (JCDecaux), Breathe Through It (Halls), #TurnYourBack (Dove), The Bald Thru (Burger King); and Alcaraz Signs (Netflix).

Throughout its history, DAVID has been one of the most recognized agencies for creating Super Bowl commercials, producing 9 spots over 6 years. In 2019 alone, the agency created commercials for three different clients (Burger King, Kraft Heinz, Budweiser).


About the Role

As Senior Producer, you will be responsible for end-to-end management of production projects including but not limited to broadcast productions, social video production, still shoots, social, experiential/activations and/or mobile platform campaigns. You are responsible for delivering a completed project on time, on specification, and on budget. The Senior Producer also manages senior-level relationships and oversees implementation of tactical plans while ensuring deliverables are on strategy and meet quality standards. The Senior Producer may directly manage other producers. You must demonstrate an excellent understanding of project management tools and best-practice methodology, and flexibility to lead diverse and dynamic teams to deliver balanced integrated solutions.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage large projects independently from initiation through completion
  • Oversee all production activities (pre-production, shoots, post-production)
  • Work with stakeholders to create, develop, produce, and deliver content to our client
  • Liaise across departments and brand leads including account services, creative teams, production consultants, brand leads, strategy, business affairs, etc
  • Serve as the expert on integrated marketing campaigns, working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced joint agency environment
  • Serve as the main agency contact on your projects: help define and maintain vision, clarify strategic requirements, demystify complex ideas, and manage team expectations
  • Develop realistic and justifiable estimates, scope and timeline for all projects, and be accountable for the scope and budget as the project progresses
  • Track ongoing costs throughout project lifecycle, and reconcile estimates to actuals on all projects
  • Proactively identify project issues/risks, assists in issue/risk resolution
  • Meets regularly with key stakeholders to contribute toward the overall development and health of the account
  • Ongoing review of production process and practices with an eye toward enhancing and increasing effectiveness
  • Manages a small to mid-size team to successfully execute programs/projects
  • Manages multiple projects within time/budget constraints
  • Optimizes workstreams and finds ways to create output more efficiently (e.g., team reallocation)
  • Mentors junior members of the team in problem solving/course correcting projects
  • Is an experienced, calm leader of the internal and external cross-functional team – inspires team to strive for superior client results and team accomplishments; proactively identifies and solves conflict among team members
  • Experience across the production lifecycle from in-camera capture to multi-channel deployment
  • Strong understanding of the post process and the resources needed to deliver projects across stills, video, animation and digital


What You’ll Need

  • 4+ years of production experience in an interactive or integrated agency or similar environment
  • Experience with live action, celebrities, SAG, animation, experiential, etc
  • Demonstrated ability to solve problems with the solution that works for all parties without compromising the quality of the deliverables or the project
  • Innate understanding of the project finance, staffing and profitability and the relationship to project management
  • Successful history of project leadership to clients and account, with demonstrable experience in setting and managing stakeholder expectations

title: SOCIAL MEDIA ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE
description:

Buscamos un/a Account Executive con pasión por el social media para unirse a nuestro equipo y trabajar con uno de nuestros clientes más icónicos y desafiantes: una reconocida marca global del sector QSR, famosa por su comunicación audaz, su humor y su presencia digital disruptiva. Si te encanta la velocidad del mundo digital y tienes ganas de dejar tu huella en campañas que dan la vuelta al mundo, ¡esta es tu oportunidad!

Tu misión principal será:

Ser el/la punto de contacto diario entre la agencia y el cliente para todas las iniciativas de social media.
Apoyar al Account Supervisor en la gestión y ejecución de campañas digitales innovadoras y estrategias de contenido.
Coordinar el flujo de trabajo interno, asegurando que los briefs lleguen al equipo creativo y de estrategia con claridad y a tiempo.
Supervisar la entrega de materiales, timelines y presupuestos, garantizando la calidad y eficiencia en cada proyecto.
Monitorear tendencias en redes sociales y el desempeño de las campañas, identificando oportunidades y aprendizajes clave para informar al cliente.
Elaborar reportes de resultados y presentaciones concisas y atractivas para el cliente.
Colaborar estrechamente con los equipos creativo, de estrategia y de medios para producir trabajo excepcional que resuene con las audiencias.


Lo que buscamos en ti:

1-2 años de experiencia previa como Account Executive o rol similar en una agencia de publicidad o digital, con un foco claro en social media.
Fuerte comprensión del ecosistema de redes sociales (Instagram, TikTok, X, YouTube, etc.) y sus tendencias más recientes.
Excelentes habilidades de comunicación oral y escrita, y capacidad para construir relaciones sólidas con el cliente.
Proactividad, autonomía y una gran capacidad de organización y gestión de proyectos.
Atención al detalle y habilidad para manejar múltiples tareas simultáneamente en un entorno dinámico.
Mentalidad analítica para interpretar datos y resultados, y transformarlos en insights accionables.
Nivel de inglés: mínimo B2, deseable C1
Pasión por la creatividad, la innovación y el mundo de las marcas que no temen ser diferentes.


¿Qué te ofrecemos en DAVID?

La oportunidad de gestionar una de las marcas más atrevidas y creativas del sector QSR a nivel global.
Un ambiente de trabajo dinámico, desafiante y lleno de talento, donde la disrupción es la norma.
La posibilidad de crecer profesionalmente en una agencia reconocida mundialmente por su excelencia creativa y sus premios.
Participar en proyectos que cambian la conversación y dejan una marca imborrable.
Un equipo que valora la colaboración, el buen rollo y la ambición por hacer cosas grandes.

We’re seeking a highly motivated and experienced Social Media Strategist. The ideal candidate will be a lover of creativity who works proactively and collaboratively, possesses a consistent pulse on social media updates, industry news, and pop culture, and excels at managing multiple tasks.

  • Articulate the team's content strategy, execution plans, and performance results to internal stakeholders and clients.


What You’ll Need

  • Expert-level knowledge of algorithms and best practices for key social platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Pinterest, and emerging platforms.
  • Experience managing influencer marketing campaigns and overseeing community management.
  • Proven ability to develop and drive content strategy, including video, photography, and high-level copywriting aligned with brand voice.
  • Demonstrated experience presenting strategies, performance insights, and recommendations to senior clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with social media management tools, analytics platforms, and content creation workflows.
  • Experience with social listening tools like Brandwatch is a plus.
